overview.purpose_zh: 这张动态条形图按季度播放各地区的销售额排名，用来看一段时间里名次怎么变，而不是读每一格的精确数字。
works_zh: 讲一段时间里的排名更替
在演示中制造节奏和悬念

understanding.read_zh: 先看最后一帧的名次，再从头播放，注意哪一根柱子在哪一帧超过了另一根。

elements.note_zh: 每根柱子是一个地区，长度表示当季销售额。
柱子从上到下按数值排序，位置本身就是名次。
每一帧是一个季度，播放时柱子的长度和位置都会变。
柱子旁边的数字是当季数值，用来核对变化。

observations.en: East holds first place in every quarter, rising from 420 to 690.
observations.zh: 东部每个季度都排第一，从 420 升到 690。

observations.en: South stays second throughout, from 310 to 452.
observations.zh: 南部始终第二，从 310 到 452。

observations.en: The only rank change comes in 2025-Q2, when West moves ahead of North at 326 against 305.
observations.zh: 唯一的名次变化发生在 2025-Q2：西部以 326 对 305 超过北部。

observations.en: West climbs from 190 to 415, the largest relative gain of the four regions.
observations.zh: 西部从 190 升到 415，是四个地区里相对涨幅最大的。

observations.en: North finishes last at 334, although it also grew from 260.
observations.zh: 北部最终以 334 垫底，尽管它也从 260 增长了。

observations.en: The gap between East and South widens from 110 to 238.
observations.zh: 东部和南部之间的差距从 110 扩大到 238。

describe.en: The chart shows how the four regions' sales ranks change from 2024-Q1 to 2025-Q4.
describe.zh: 这张图显示四个地区的销售额排名从 2024-Q1 到 2025-Q4 怎么变化。
describe.pattern: The chart shows how + subject + change + from ... to ...
alternatives: It follows the ranking of four regions across eight quarters.
The race covers eight quarters, from early 2024 to late 2025.
describe.note_zh: 动态图开头要点明时间跨度，读者才知道动画在播什么。

describe.en: In the final quarter the order is East, South, West and North, with 690, 452, 415 and 334 respectively.
describe.zh: 最后一个季度的顺序是东部、南部、西部、北部，数值分别为 690、452、415 和 334。
describe.pattern: A, B, C and D + verb + w, x, y and z + respectively
alternatives: East, South, West and North finish at 690, 452, 415 and 334 respectively.
The last frame reads East 690, South 452, West 415 and North 334.
describe.note_zh: respectively 要求两串信息的顺序严格对应，写之前先核对名次。

describe.en: North lags behind the other three regions, with 334 in the final quarter.
describe.zh: 北部落后于其他三个地区，最后一个季度只有 334。
alternatives: North ends last on 334, behind West's 415.
By the final frame North is the smallest region, at 334.
describe.note_zh: lag behind 不只是数值低，还带有“被甩在后面”的评价。

describe.en: West increases from 190 in 2024-Q1 to 415 in 2025-Q4.
alternatives: West rises from 190 to 415 over the eight quarters.
West grows by 225 across the period.
describe.note_zh: 同时给出起点和终点，读者才能判断这个涨幅在四个地区里算不算快。

describe.en: East finishes at 690, higher than South at 452.
describe.zh: 东部最终为 690，高于南部的 452。
alternatives: South ends 238 behind East, at 452 against 690.
describe.note_zh: 谈第一名时把它和第二名并排，差距比单独报一个数更清楚。

describe.en: What stands out is how little the top two positions change while West climbs past North.
describe.zh: 最突出的是前两名几乎没变，而西部越过了北部。
describe.pattern: What stands out is + noun clause
alternatives: The clear story is stability at the top and one rank change below.
The only crossing comes in 2025-Q2, when West moves ahead of North.
describe.note_zh: 动画看完整段再下结论，不要停在某一帧就概括全片。

academic.en: The bar race animates the ranking of four regions across eight quarters, from 2024-Q1 to 2025-Q4. East is ranked first in every frame, with values rising from 420 to 690, while South is consistently placed second, moving from 310 to 452. The only reordering occurs in the lower half: West overtakes North in 2025-Q2, at 326 against 305, and is then ranked third until the end. By the final quarter the order is East, South, West and North, with values of 690, 452, 415 and 334 respectively.
academic.zh: 这张动态条形图把四个地区在八个季度的排名从 2024-Q1 播放到 2025-Q4。东部在每一帧都排第一，数值从 420 升到 690；南部始终排在第二，从 310 到 452。唯一的名次调整发生在下半区：西部在 2025-Q2 以 326 对 305 超过北部，此后一直排在第三。到最后一个季度，顺序是东部、南部、西部、北部，数值分别为 690、452、415 和 334。

business.en: Our read of this race is stability at the top and a squeeze at the bottom. East leads all eight quarters and finishes at 690, up 270, while our second region, South, holds at 452. West is the mover we should watch: it passes North in 2025-Q2 at 326 against 305 and ends at 415, a gain of 225 on its opening 190. North still grows to 334 but loses third place. The East-South gap widens from 110 to 238, and that is the pattern. We should treat the leader as pulling away and plan our regional support accordingly.
business.zh: 我们对这张图的解读是：顶部稳定，底部被挤压。东部八个季度都领先，最终收在 690，增加 270；我们的第二个地区南部守在 452。西部是我们应该关注的变量：2025-Q2 以 326 对 305 超过北部，最后到 415，比开局的 190 多了 225。北部虽然增长到 334，还是丢掉第三。东部和南部的差距从 110 扩大到 238，因此我们应把领先者视为在拉开距离，并据此安排区域支持。

simple.en: East is first in every quarter. It starts at 420 and ends at 690. South stays second the whole way, from 310 to 452. West starts at the bottom with 190 and finishes third at 415. North starts third at 260 and finishes at the bottom with 334. In 2025-Q2, West goes past North. East keeps the lead from start to finish. All the change happens behind it.
simple.zh: 东部每个季度都是第一，从 420 开始，到 690 结束。南部一直排第二，从 310 到 452。西部从最末的 190 起步，最后排第三，为 415。北部从第三的 260 起步，最后落到最末的 334。2025-Q2 西部超过了北部。东部从头到尾保持领先，变化都发生在它后面。

language_notes.body_zh: 动画由一帧一帧组成，这里的每一帧就是一个季度。说 in 2025-Q2，不说 at 2025-Q2；跨帧比较用 between ... and ...。
examples: The order is the same in 2025-Q1 and 2025-Q2.

language_notes.body_zh: 名次互换用 overtake 或 pass，一直领先用 stay ahead of。不要说 win，因为这里只争第三名。
examples: East stays ahead of South in every quarter.

language_notes.body_zh: 排名看的是相对位置，不是数值有没有增长。北部的 334 比开局的 260 高，但因为西部涨得更快，它还是掉到最后。
examples: North rises from 260 to 334 but still finishes last.
West's 415 is enough for third, while North's 334 is not.
